Bay Area Birthday Party DJ

2026 BIRTHDAY PARTY DISC JOCKEY
Birthdays Offer a special opportunity to celebrate life itself. From birth, to age 100, every year we pass another significant milestone in life. At california disc jockey we are happy to share in these special celebrations. We offer professional disc jockey and emcee services to provide a birthday party to remember. If your birthday honoree is reaching a milestone and turning Sweet 16, 18, 21, 30, 40, 50, 60, 80th or greater, they deserve the best possible party memories.

CLICK TO SUBMIT YOUR BIRTHDAY PARTY EVENT ENQUIRY

\
Sweet Sixteen
Sweet 16’s can range from pure elegance to outrageous fun. You need DJs who can appeal to a younger audience, with all of the latest Music Like Bay Area Songs and mixing abilities that will guarantee to pack the dance floor,Also We can play The beatles happy birthday as well as sixteen candles. Some popular group dances include Cupid Shuffle, Cha Cha Slide, The Tik Tok Challenge Song.

Our Bay Area Disc Jockeys  is knowledgeable about what an older crowd may want, should your guests be mixed in ages.

MTV Sweet Sixteen


Ask About our Premium Led Dance Floor Packages and Photo Booths & Uplighting.

Tired of seeing the big budget parties get all the fame?

Want to showcase your party and put it up against someone else’s to see who comes out on top?  MTV is searching for teens who are throwing a Sweet 16 in the next few months who want to do just that.

If this sounds like you, please contact us and send us your party date and contact info.:

Bay Area Birthday Party DJ – Questions & Answers
Why hire a Bay Area Birthday Party DJ?
Birthdays are milestones worth celebrating! Our California Disc Jockey team provides professional DJ and MC services for Sweet 16, 18th, 21st, 30th, 40th, 50th, 60th, 80th birthdays and beyond. We bring high-energy music, lighting, and interactive entertainment to make your birthday unforgettable.

☎ Call 1-415-350-5474 to book your celebration.
Do you play music for all ages?
Yes! We customize our playlists for mixed-age parties:
  • Teens: Latest Hip Hop, TikTok hits, Pop & Dance music
  • Adults: 70s, 80s, 90s, Motown, Rock, Oldies
  • Family-friendly events: Clean Radio Edits only
We can even play “The Beatles – Happy Birthday” or “Sixteen Candles” for classic moments.
What special packages do you offer for birthdays?
Our birthday party upgrades include:
  • LED Dance Floor to light up your party
  • Photo Booth with instant prints and props
  • Uplighting to match your birthday theme
  • Low Laying Dry Ice Fog for dramatic entrances
  • Interactive games and group dance contests
Perfect for Sweet 16, Quinceañera, Debut, or milestone birthdays!
Can you create a timeline for our birthday party?
Yes! A typical birthday party timeline includes:
  1. Guest Arrival with Background Music
  2. Games and Interactive DJ Activities
  3. Cake Cutting Ceremony with Happy Birthday Song
  4. Group Dances: Cupid Shuffle, Cha Cha Slide, TikTok Challenge
  5. Open Dance Floor with Requests
  6. Last Dance & Party Send-Off
We’ll help you plan every moment for maximum fun and energy.
Do you handle house parties and private events?
Absolutely! We provide House Party DJs for small or large gatherings with a professional sound system and optional lighting effects. Whether it’s a backyard celebration or a ballroom event, we’ll make your birthday a night to remember.
How do I book my Bay Area Birthday DJ?
Booking is easy!
  • Call 1-415-350-5474 to reserve your party date
  • Submit your event details via our online Birthday Party Enquiry form
  • Ask about Photo Booth & LED Dance Floor Packages
Don’t wait – popular dates fill fast!
